-- name: Sentry_Kcor
-- Generated by scripts/quests/velious-backlog.mjs; edit server/internal/quest/velious_backlog_quests.json.
-- P99: https://wiki.project1999.com/Helms_of_Giant_Warriors (sha256 c0eec1a02e6e39cf2d838b98ec6fe06c12b3572fb64086a0e7a46c8ff508c5e2)
-- Original: server/internal/quest/upstream/projecteq/skyshrine/Sentry_Kcor.pl (sha256 8e9c127537b8eb81ecab15b6e97dd03bfecdfb7ac32cb5a4cb543bc48f01b942)
-- P99-reviewed Velious content. Quest faction gates deliberately bypassed; actual faction rewards retained.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("Be quick for the Guardians may not appreciate you leaving your post.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 29062 }) then
    e.self:Say("Very good, you are on your way to proving yourself.")
    e.other:Faction(430, 5, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 5, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -5, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 29624 }) then
    e.self:Say("Ahhh yes! Well done " .. e.other:GetClassName() .. ". Here is your reward. Your status with our people grows with each interloper you eradicate.")
    e.other:AddMoneyToPP(13, 6, 6, 0, true)
    e.other:Faction(430, 5, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 5, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -5, 0)
  end
  -- Return unrelated and surplus offers on both accepted and rejected trades.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

-- name: Sentry_Kcor
-- Generated by scripts/quests/velious-backlog.mjs; edit server/internal/quest/velious_backlog_quests.json.
-- P99: https://wiki.project1999.com/Helms_of_Giant_Warriors (sha256 c0eec1a02e6e39cf2d838b98ec6fe06c12b3572fb64086a0e7a46c8ff508c5e2)
-- Original: server/internal/quest/upstream/projecteq/skyshrine/Sentry_Kcor.pl (sha256 8e9c127537b8eb81ecab15b6e97dd03bfecdfb7ac32cb5a4cb543bc48f01b942)
-- P99-reviewed Velious content. Quest faction gates deliberately bypassed; actual faction rewards retained.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("Halt, who goes there? Hmmm. What manner of strangers are you? Let it be known that the Kin hold no love for outsiders, only those truly [worthy] may walk amongst the Kin.")
  elseif e.message:findi("worthy") then
    e.self:Say("The vile giants, their hearts colder than the ice of Velious, wish to slay our kind and take the land for their own. Their warriors wear helms of the finest steel, should you slay these warriors, return their helms and your worth to the Kin shall grow.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 29062 }) then
    -- P99 documents one through four helmets per trade, with no experience.
    for i = 1, 4 do
      e.self:Say("Very good, you are on your way to proving yourself.")
      e.other:Faction(430, 15, 0)
      e.other:Faction(436, 3, 0)
      e.other:Faction(448, -7, 0)
      if i == 4 or not item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 29062 }) then break end
    end
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 29624 }) then
    -- Mercenary Assignments, NOT Storm Giant Toes. Keep its uncertain cash and Kromzek magnitude.
    for i = 1, 4 do
      e.self:Say("Ahhh yes! Well done " .. e.other:GetClassName() .. ". Here is your reward. Your status with our people grows with each interloper you eradicate.")
      e.other:AddMoneyToPP(13, 6, 6, 0, true)
      e.other:Faction(430, 6, 0)
      e.other:Faction(436, 6, 0)
      e.other:Faction(448, -5, 0)
      if i == 4 or not item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 29624 }) then break end
    end
  end
  -- Storm Giant Toes29124 remains absent: the P99 coin log is not a verified fixed payout.
  -- Return unrelated and surplus offers on both accepted and rejected trades.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
